summary: Iteration 12 verifies (1) new 4-digit reset-PIN feature and (2) reels screen-fit / playback contract. 9/9 new iteration-12 backend tests PASS and 52/52 prior-iteration regression tests still PASS (iter6/8/9/10/11 + push + purge = 61/61 in scoped run, 18.30s). All feature-1 endpoints work per spec: GET /api/auth/reset-pin returns {enabled,set_at} (never hash); POST /api/auth/reset-pin with wrong current_password → 403 'Invalid credentials', with correct pw → 200 {status:ok,enabled:true} and sets set_at; UserPublic.reset_pin_enabled flips true in /api/auth/me. POST /api/auth/forgot-password-pin with correct email+PIN → 200 with fresh JWT, rotates password (old rejected, new works); 5 wrong PINs → 5x 403 then 6th → 429 with Retry-After header; unknown email → 403 identical shape with wall-clock >20ms (no enumeration leak); PIN cleared with pin:null → 200 {status:cleared,enabled:false} and subsequent forgot-password-pin returns 403. Feature 2 static contract on /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/reels.tsx: useWindowDimensions imported and destructured for SCREEN_H/SCREEN_W inside ReelsScreen; NO top-level Dimensions.get('window') for SCREEN_H/W; useEvent(player,'playingChange',...) present; tapToPlayPill style present; ReelItemProps includes height:number and width:number; useEvent statusChange retained; pagingEnabled retained; width applied inline via [styles.reel,{width,height}]. GET /api/reels returns founder's reel with H.264-forced URL (f_mp4,vc_h264,q_auto). Metro bundles cleanly: curl localhost:3000 → 200 and localhost:3000/(tabs)/reels → 200. Teardown verified: founder password restored to Semi123! and PIN cleared (GET /api/auth/reset-pin → {enabled:false,set_at:null}) — downstream iterations start clean.

minor.issue: Returns HTTP 400 'Incorrect email or password' on wrong password instead of the more standard 401. Not new to iteration 12 — pre-existing behavior. Test asserts 400/401/403 tolerantly.

Housekeeping (out-of-scope, pre-existing): /app/backend/tests/test_postmeplex_api.py and /app/backend/tests/test_iteration2_features.py depend on the old seeded alex@postmeplex.com / maria@postmeplex.com accounts which have been removed per the clean-slate rule in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. These files should be either deleted or rewritten to register their own TEST_* users. NOT introduced by iteration 12 — same status as iteration 11.

Housekeeping: iteration-8/9 push_edge_cases + push_pipeline tests create tec_*/tpb_* reels with example.com video_urls; when they run in the same pytest session BEFORE reels contract tests, /api/reels returns those first and shadows the founder reel. Auto-purge only fires on backend restart. Recommend running purge-sensitive tests in a separate session OR making test_iteration8_reels.py / iteration9 / iteration12 filter reels by author.username=='semidiepie' rather than 'first item'. iteration_12 test already filters by author before falling back to first, so it passes standalone; scoped regression run confirms 61/61.
critical_code_review_comments: PIN hashing pipeline is correct: bcrypt(salt) over (normalized_pin + server_pepper). Pepper lives in backend/.env (PIN_PEPPER) and is never stored in Mongo — with only 10⁴ PIN combinations this defense is essential. verify_pin_hash catches all bcrypt exceptions and returns False (constant-time-ish failure).

Enumeration defense via _DUMMY_PIN_HASH is well done: computed once at import (stable timing), verified both when the email is unknown AND when the account has no PIN — so all three failure modes take similar wall-clock time. Test confirms >20ms per call.

Lockout logic: reset_pin_failed_attempts increments per wrong PIN, at MAX_PIN_ATTEMPTS (5) the counter is reset to 0 AND reset_pin_locked_until = now+15min. Successful PIN clears both. Setting/updating the PIN via /api/auth/reset-pin also clears the counter — this is the escape hatch used by test_07 to unlock founder mid-suite. This is intentional and safe because /api/auth/reset-pin requires the current password (JWT alone is insufficient).
UserPublic.reset_pin_enabled derived from bool(reset_pin_hash) — hash itself is never serialized. Confirmed via /api/auth/me: response contains reset_pin_enabled but no reset_pin_hash field.
SetResetPinBody uses pattern=r'^\d{4}$' with Optional[str]; pin=null path unsets four fields via $unset. Server-side idempotent — unsetting already-unset fields is a no-op.

Reels reactive dimensions fix is clean: useWindowDimensions() reads inside the component so it re-computes on rotation, safe-area layout changes, iPad split-view, etc. width and height are passed as ReelItemProps, applied inline via [styles.reel, { width, height }] — no stale module-level cache. useEvent(player,'playingChange',...) drives the tap-to-play overlay for iOS autoplay refusals — good fallback UX.
H.264 forcing (f_mp4,vc_h264,q_auto) from iteration 9 preserved end-to-end — /api/reels returns the transformed URL for the founder's Cloudinary asset.

context_for_next_testing_agent: 1) Founder Reset-PIN is UNSET by default (per test_credentials.md). Any test that sets it MUST clear it before exit — the pattern to use is: POST /api/auth/reset-pin {current_password,pin:null} which also resets the failed-attempts counter and lockout window (this is the escape hatch used to unlock mid-suite). 2) Lockout on the forgot-password-pin flow is per-user for 15 REAL minutes; do NOT sleep to wait it out — instead call POST /api/auth/reset-pin to reset the counter (server code clears both fields on set). 3) The 429 response carries Retry-After header (seconds) — assert both status and header. 4) Enumeration defense: unknown-email path calls verify_pin_hash against _DUMMY_PIN_HASH; expect wall-clock >20ms per call. 5) Reels ordering: /api/reels is unordered across sessions with test-created tec_/tpb_ reels; auto-purge runs ONLY on backend startup. If reels tests fail due to leftover TEST reels, `sudo supervisorctl restart backend` triggers purge_test_scratch_accounts(). Iteration-12 reels test filters by author before falling back to first, so it's robust. 6) UserPublic gained reset_pin_enabled: bool — Consumers of /api/auth/me may need to handle the new field but it defaults to false for accounts that never set a PIN. 7) email-based reset endpoints (/forgot-password, /verify-reset-code, /reset-password) are still functional for BC — no code changes there in iter12.
rca_of_issue: Original two-part user report handled cleanly. Part A ('reels don't fit screen properly'): root cause was module-level `const { width, height } = Dimensions.get('window')` executing at bundle-load — on iOS this fires BEFORE safe-area insets stabilize, so the reel view's hardcoded width overflowed. Fix moved the read into ReelsScreen via useWindowDimensions() (reactive to rotation & safe-area) and threaded {width,height} down to ReelItem as props, applied inline. Part B ('won't play the video'): root cause was iOS Safari + Expo web preview refusing autoplay on some devices even with the muted/inline flags set. Fix: subscribe to useEvent(player,'playingChange',...) and — when active && !paused && status==='readyToPlay' && !isPlaying — render a `Tap to play` pill overlay so the user can trigger playback manually. H.264 forcing from iteration 9 is retained (f_mp4,vc_h264,q_auto), which is what makes the codec decodable in the first place on iOS. Part C ('reset password thing with 4-digit PIN'): PIN system replaces the older Resend-email code flow (which is still available for BC). Storage uses bcrypt over (normalized_pin + PIN_PEPPER) — pepper never in DB. Rate-limit (5→lock 15min) + constant-time dummy verify defeat brute force + enumeration. No mocks; nothing off-limits.
